page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6.4xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a base clock frequency of 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. Managed under a KVM hypervisor, the instance provides 16 dedicated virtual CPUs across 8 physical cores with 2 hyperthreads per core. Hardware memory capacity is 32.0 GB, maintaining a compute-focused ratio of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. The processor cache hierarchy includes 32 KB of L1 instruction/data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache per core, and a 35 MB shared L3 cache. Supported hardware extensions include AVX-512 with VNNI, AES, BMI2, ADX, and FMA. The server features no local SSD or NVMe storage attached by default, provides 5 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth, and includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Performance profiles demonstrate clear multi-threading efficiency alongside moderate single-core throughput. Stress-ng single-core tests and single-threaded compression evaluations (such as gzip at 22.76 GB/sec) perform in the bottom 25th percentile. Conversely, multi-threaded workloads exhibit average middle-tier performance, evidenced by a multi-core stress-ng score of 13975.48, a Geekbench multi-core score of 7299.0, and a PassMark CPU score of 15380.43. Uncached memory bandwidth reaches 88.67 GB/sec for reads and 45.93 GB/sec for writes. Application benchmarks yield 13.44 million Redis SET operations per second and a static web serving throughput of 11.29 GB/sec.

The ecs.c6.4xlarge instance provides qualitative resource efficiency for parallelized processing tasks that do not require dedicated local ephemeral disks or discrete GPU accelerators. The combination of dedicated hyperthreaded cores, 32 GB of system RAM, and baseline network throughput makes this instance appropriate for web server arrays, software compilation, multi-threaded data processing, and application backends connected to remote block storage.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6.4xlarge is a compute-optimized instance based on the x86_64 Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. Managed via a KVM hypervisor, it features 16 dedicated vCPUs (8 physical cores with 2 threads per core), 32.0 GB of memory (2.0 GB per vCPU), and a 35 MB L3 cache, with AVX-512 vector extensions supported. Networking provides 5 Gbps of baseline bandwidth. The instance features no bundled local storage or GPUs. Benchmark evaluations show weak single-core CPU throughput and single-threaded compression performance, while multi-threaded benchmarks—including PassMark, Geekbench multi-core, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression—consistently perform within average ranges. Web serving reaches 11.29 GB/sec and Redis SET operations deliver 13.44 million ops/sec. The instance delivers cost-effective resource allocation for multi-threaded applications, software compilation, web serving, and distributed batch processing tasks relying on network storage.
